families.conditions: The Hom-over-field and Hom-over-point finiteness lemmas need a finite morphism and an arbitrary field, not etaleness or a separably closed field. FiniteEtale X is the full subcategory of Over X selected by Scheme.finiteEtaleProperty. Actual scheme pullback and geometric fibers are retained; empty covers are allowed. Only the explicit comparison to the small etale site assumes a separably closed field.

families.source_identity_note: Git2f9 commit/blob identity and the guarded current pre-deletion input are distinct fields. Both happen to have equal bytes in these two paths; no prior consumer-refactor modification is present in their accepted inputs.

conditions.ring: Independent R/A/B universes; commutative rings and the actual algebra structures; B a domain; A essentially finite type and formally unramified over R; a prime ideal Q and actual equality of quotient algebra maps. No nilpotent-ideal, field or Noetherian hypothesis is added.
conditions.scheme: The actual map p is separated, formally unramified and locally of finite type. The actual map q is geometrically connected and has the supplied section. Both displayed map equations remain explicit. No field, reducedness or Noetherian premise is added.
